logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Collect, review, and analyze application logs in one place.

guide.title: How to Collect Logs
guide.subtitle: Start collecting logs and API traces through OpenTelemetry OTLP. No product-specific SDK or collector is required.

step1.title: Create a Log Service
step1.desc: Click "Add Log" and create a service name. A dedicated API key is generated automatically for that service.

step2.title: Connect OpenTelemetry
step2.desc: Open the Integration tab, set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, then send logs and traces through the standard OTLP endpoint.

step3.title: Review Logs and Add Alerts
step3.desc: Collected logs appear in the log list right away. If needed, add Telegram or Discord alert rules for error and warn logs.

logs.pausedMessage: Log updates are paused. Click Resume to restart.

logServices.emptyDesc: Add a log service, then connect your application with OpenTelemetry OTLP.

add.title: Add Log
add.infoDesc: Create a log service to generate an API key automatically. Then connect your app with OpenTelemetry in the Integration tab.

edit.title: Edit Log Service
edit.subtitle: Update service name and log level filter.
edit.levelFilterDesc: Select which log levels the server will store.
edit.levelFilterHint: Defaults to error / warn / info — debug and trace must be explicitly enabled.
edit.excludePathsDesc: API requests matching these paths are dropped before storage. End with * for prefix matching (e.g. /actuator/*).
edit.excludePathsEmpty: No exclusions — all paths are captured.
edit.excludePathsHint: Common: /, /health, /actuator/*. Matches url.path on incoming OTLP spans.

validation.idFormat: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens are allowed

toast.createdGuide: Log added. Copy the integration code below to start collecting logs.

loggingLibrary.title: Send Directly From App Code
loggingLibrary.desc: Add HTTP sending to your existing logging library such as Winston, Logback, or Serilog. This is usually the easiest option when you can modify application code.

http.title: Direct HTTP POST
http.desc: Send logs with plain HTTP POST from any language or platform. This works well for scripts or custom log forwarding logic.

delete.subtitle: This action cannot be undone

apiKey.revealOnce: This key is shown only once. Copy it now.

settings.levelFilterDesc: Choose which log levels this service stores. Unselected levels are silently dropped at ingest time.
settings.acceptAllDesc: error / warn / info by default, debug and trace are opt-in
settings.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one log level.
settings.summaryAll: Collecting: error / warn / info / debug / trace
settings.summaryNone: No levels selected - nothing will be collected

picker.title: Connect with OpenTelemetry
picker.subtitle: Use the standard OTLP endpoint for logs and traces.
picker.notSureDesc: Start with OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation. It sends logs and traces together and keeps request correlation intact.

otel.label: OpenTelemetry
otel.tagline: Send logs and traces with the OTLP standard
otel.description: Attach OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation and configure a few environment variables. Your app emits logs and traces to /api/v1/otlp directly.
goodFor: See logs and API traces correlated
Standard SDK, no app code changes

endpoint.title: Ingest endpoint
endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL for logs and traces.
endpoint.otelDescription: OTLP/HTTP base URL. The SDK appends /v1/logs and /v1/traces automatically.

test.title: Test the connection first
test.description: Send one small log entry before changing production logging. The status updates when a log arrives.
test.troubleshootingDesc: If the request reaches a reverse proxy, make sure the Authorization header is forwarded.

setup.otelDesc: Pick your language, set the environment variables, and attach the auto-instrumentation agent. No code changes required.
setup.otelHint: Point OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT at EveryUp and the SDK fans out to /v1/logs and /v1/traces automatically. Pass the issued API key as the Authorization header.

modals.regenerateDesc: The previous key stops working immediately. Update any running OpenTelemetry exporters.
modals.newKeyDesc: Copy it now. It will be hidden again shortly.

toast.regenerateFirst: Regenerate the API key first, then try the browser test.
